TABLE.NAME: block_fastlearning_ra
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the Learning Resources (RA) assigned to users

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the student assigned to the RA

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course where the RA is assigned

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course module instance (nullable if it is just a need draft)

FIELD.NAME: global
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the RA is assigned at the site level (1) or course level (0)

FIELD.NAME: competencyid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the competency assigned at the site level (optional)

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Manual name of the RA in case it does not have an associated competency

FIELD.NAME: urgencylevel
FIELD.COMMENT: Assigned urgency level (0 is the highest priority)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Current status of the RA (e.g., pending, finished)

TABLE.NAME: block_fastlearning_levels
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the urgency levels configuration for the block

FIELD.NAME: urgencylevel
FIELD.COMMENT: Numeric priority level (0 is the highest priority)

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the urgency level (e.g., Critical, Normal)

FIELD.NAME: minutes
FIELD.COMMENT: Minutes allowed to complete the resource before it expires

FIELD.NAME: icon
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle pix icon name and class (e.g., core:a/search or mod_scorm:passed)
